description: Preview a merge without changing anything: files that would be taken from the source, items added/moved/deleted, and conflicts. Without destination the target is the workspace branch; with destination the preview is computed on the server for that branch. Read-only.

destination.description: Optional destination branch such as /main. Omit to preview a merge into the current workspace.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of conflicts, and separately of changes, to return, from 1 to 5000. Default: 300. Counts always cover everything.

source.description: Merge source: a branch such as /main/task, cs:94, lb:LABEL, or sh:12.

name: uvcs_merge_preview
